excerpt: To this end, we continually evaluate and improve robustness to adversarial attacks that seek to remove xAI model safeguards (e.g., jailbreak attacks), or hijack and redirect Grok-powered applications toward nefarious purposes (e.g., prompt injection attacks).
paraphrase: xAI continually works on robustness against jailbreak and prompt injection attacks.

excerpt: To transparently measure our models’ safety properties, xAI utilizes public benchmarks like Weapons of Mass Destruction Proxy and Catastrophic Harm Benchmarks (described below).
paraphrase: xAI uses public benchmarks like WMDP to measure model safety properties transparently.

excerpt: Such benchmarks are used to measure our model’s dual-use capability and resistance to facilitating large-scale violence, terrorism, or the use, development, or proliferation of weapons of mass destruction (including CBRN and major cyber weapons).
paraphrase: Benchmarks measure dual-use capability and resistance to facilitating violence and WMD proliferation.

excerpt: In particular, we utilize the following benchmarks:

context_stem: In particular, we utilize the following benchmarks:
excerpt: Virology Capabilities Test (VCT): VCT is a benchmark of dual-use multimodal questions on practical virology wet lab skills, sourced by dozens of expert virologists.
paraphrase: VCT is a benchmark testing dual-use practical virology wet lab knowledge.

context_stem: In particular, we utilize the following benchmarks:
excerpt: Weapons of Mass Destruction Proxy (WMDP) Benchmark: WMDP is a set of multiple-choice questions to enable proxy measurement of hazardous knowledge in biosecurity, cybersecurity, and chemical security.
paraphrase: WMDP is a multiple-choice benchmark proxy-measuring hazardous biosecurity, cybersecurity, and chemical security knowledge.

context_stem: Weapons of Mass Destruction Proxy (WMDP) Benchmark description.
excerpt: WMDP-Bio includes questions on topics such as bioweapons, reverse genetics, enhanced potential pandemic pathogens, viral vector research, and dual-use virology.
paraphrase: WMDP-Bio covers bioweapons, reverse genetics, pandemic pathogens, viral vector research, and dual-use virology topics.

context_stem: Weapons of Mass Destruction Proxy (WMDP) Benchmark description.
excerpt: WMDP-Cyber encompasses cyber reconnaissance, weaponization, exploitation, and post-exploitation.
paraphrase: WMDP-Cyber covers cyber reconnaissance, weaponization, exploitation, and post-exploitation.

context_stem: In particular, we utilize the following benchmarks:
excerpt: Biological Lab Protocol Benchmark (BioLP-bench): BioLP-bench has modified biology protocols, in which an AI model must identify the mistake in the protocol.
paraphrase: BioLP-bench tests whether an AI model can identify errors in modified biology protocols.

excerpt: Responses are open-ended, rather than multiple-choice.
paraphrase: BioLP-bench uses open-ended responses instead of multiple-choice format.

excerpt: To construct the dataset, protocols were modified by introducing a single mistake that would cause the protocol to fail, as well as additional benign changes.
paraphrase: The dataset was built by introducing a single failure-causing mistake plus benign changes into protocols.

context_stem: In particular, we utilize the following benchmarks:
excerpt: Cybench: Cybench is a framework for evaluating cybersecurity capabilities of AI model agents.
paraphrase: Cybench evaluates AI model agents' cybersecurity capabilities.

excerpt: It includes 40 professional-level Capture the Flag (CTF) challenges selected from six categories: cryptography, web security, reverse engineering, forensics, miscellaneous, and exploitation.
paraphrase: Cybench comprises 40 professional-level CTF challenges across six categories.

excerpt: xAI regularly evaluates the adequacy and reliability of such benchmarks, including by comparing them against other benchmarks that we could potentially utilize, to determine and apply effective benchmarks available at the time of evaluation.
paraphrase: xAI regularly assesses benchmark adequacy and reliability by comparison to alternatives.

excerpt: We may revise this list of benchmarks periodically as relevant or more effective benchmarks for malicious use are created.
paraphrase: The benchmark list may be periodically updated as better benchmarks emerge.
